title: Anbukku Naan Adimai
desc: Two brothers get separated during their childhood, with one becoming a police officer and the other turning into a gangster. Problems arise when the siblings switch places to save a village.

title: Poruthathu Pothum
desc: A lawyer locks horns with a police officer who is responsible for his mother's death. Later, he gets imprisoned due to a false accusation and reunites with his estranged father in prison.

title: Idhaya Thamarai
desc: Vijay, a short-tempered man, falls in love with Manju. However, he is imprisoned after an incident and upon his release, he learns about Manju's marriage.

title: Vallal
desc: Durairasu is heartbroken when the girl he loves marries another man. However, when the girl and her husband die in an accident, Durairasu dedicates his life to bringing up their daughter.
